value.rationale: A natural numerical optimization design problem on sparse trees is solved for the full fixed finite-tree positive-weight class at weak coupling. The result identifies exactly which orders are best, quantifies how any incorrectly oriented pair of incident interactions hurts first-sweep expected energy, and yields a checkable arbitrary-size weighted formula and Euler zigzag path-order count. The contribution is not merely a renamed or standard graph-coloring criterion: it supplies risk optimality and a sharp coefficient.
